While Democrats were busy entertaining themselves that the name of the bagged pervatives of Anies was AHY. But until now the name has not been declared the Anies that NasDem has entrusted himself with.
It's a pain in the Coalition of Changes that have always shown public solidarity, but it's actually locked in on each other.
Up until now Democrats are still pushing for AHY. While pks still think about it. NasDem seems to still be maneuvering, so Anies himself is ultimately in the middle of a lot of interest.
Choosing AHY means he should be quite an onion boy. It's exactly like a turret between two elephants.

The name AHY himself isn't selling enough. Governor DKI Jakarta has lost, let alone wanted to fight for the national level, the calculations were nowhere to be found. AHY's just a glittering display for Democrats. The crown prince must have a stage; the target is not to win but to maintain the next five years.

That's enough to get AHY satisfied even if it takes a beating. In Pilkada DKI it is also the same; the target is not to win but to train its fighter's soul to be ready for the ultimate constellation. And this is the moment we've all been waiting for. When AHY saw the odds of him next to Anies being locked up.

The Coalition of Changes needs an complement party because Nassem and PKS threshold isn't enough, while other parpol has tied themselves together. The Bacapres name they excel at surveys so it's hard to turn to another heart, let alone turn to Anies.
It's like a daydreaming. Dreams that didn't even come. The entrance of Susi's name has moved the dynamics. Earlier the names of Petrus, Khofifah and Yeni Santer were heard, but they firmly refused.
They know, moving forward with Anies can only hope that losing isn't too great, but losing is a record of their political history. A defeat that is certainly not worth remembering.
The most realistic move of Anies is to open communication with other Bacapres because the Coalition changes are so fragile.
It's better to be a sporadic but have great odds of winning than to have to win the wind and gamble in the vacuum.
But now Anies is still enjoying the show. However, the capres-president's registration is still long enough. There's still time to be ahead as one of the names that counts.

In this condition, Democrats have actually set up a jump step. They're just waiting for confirmation before the registration door is closed, because AHY can dock for Prabowo or Ganjar, of course not as cawapres.

The position of Anies in almost all surveys is also just at number 3 with a tendency to keep dropping electrability. If that trend continues, they have to be realistic about what blood is for if it's so obvious to lose.
The only hope of Anies right now is for Ganjar and Prabowo to be a couple.

That means that he still has a chance as a challenger with the record of one of those candidates having a pretty sharp electrability loss, but if their position continues to compete so tight it's difficult for Anies to take place at the Pilates. It takes a lot of capital.

The manufur Anies drama will continue. It could be the AHY's name being set if the Democrats threatened to hang out, or otherwise the party supporters of Anies were flirting with the Bacacres instead of him. Now of course Anies and AHY are still looking at each other from a distance.
